item.content:encoded:
scp-5359 (The Critter) by Pickled29 summarily deleted at -16 for being incomplete work on the mainsite. Yossipossi witnessed.

Item #: SCP-5359

Object Class: Euclid

Special Containment Procedures:

Description:

scp-5167 (A Norse Gate) by O Welles deleted at -13 and three votes.

SCP-5167 is the designation given to both an anomalous site (SCP-5167-1) and the entity that affects it (SCP-5167-2). SCP-5167-1 is a laboratory built within an fortress dated to the early 1700's near the town of ███████ in the Black Forest, Germany.

scp-5133 (Sir Ruttlesurg) by Cole 13 deleted at -12 and three votes.

Sir Ruttlesurg of England,
His teeth were sharp and his skin was quite bland,
he was so pale you'd think him undead,
If you do not sing him in song,

scp-5127 (Ghost 'n sword) by Velja Vraccarevicc deleted at -14 and three votes.

SCP-5127 appears to be a large sword composed of an unknown metal. It was discovered in Serbia, Belgrade in 2007 after a massive amount of reports of ghostly figure slaughtering people.

scp-5297 (AN EDEN AT SIGHT) by CHAZEASUS deleted at -15 and three votes.

SCP-(redacted)-Prime is a subterranean cavity of a Holocene ecosystem with a land area of

59.1 km² located 1 kilometer under,50 kilometers west of Oral Kazakhstan, dated from about 17,000 B.C.E. on carbon dating, its main biome is a Temperate Broadleaf Mixed Forest.

Feedback ported:

[+] from General Goose
– hide block

Question: What is the SCP here? There are so many entities linked to it, that it made me confused.

[+] from Cerastes 
– hide block

If you and your co authors were working on it for seven months, you definitely should've tried to get criticism at some point. There's a lot of basic errors that could've been prevented by even a cursory review.

scp-5587 (The Breathability of Argon) by solius deleted at -13 and three votes.

SCP-5587 is a gateway to an alternate dimension (SCP-5587-A) set into the trunk of an oak tree located on Mount Eisenhower at elevation of 4203 ft in White Mountain National Park, New Hampshire. When an organism comes in contact with SCP-5587, it is pulled through the tree into SCP-5587-A.

Feedback ported:

[+] from FinlandSite_Helsinki
– hide block

This SCP reminds me of the classic first SCPs of the site, more of an informational page than a thrilling story that most SCPs today must have to succeed. I think this is honestly by the book, it has all the detail we need, it’s not necessarily confusing, and it has almost zero grammatical or spelling errors which means the author put some work into making sure this is perfect. While I didn’t find this SCP particularly exciting it’s what the site was built on and feels more like an actual research log than a story that seems more like a tale which is what most current SCPs are like nowadays. Good work though! +1

wh-re-is-mine-own-gift (no title) by Joctaboom deleted at -14 and three votes.

SCP-5129 is a female creature that has two forms the first being a female albino deer and the second being a black wolf. SCP-5129 is sapient and is capable of speech however, it speaks in Early Modern English. Whenever a human is seen by SCP-5129 the first thing it will do is ask for a gift by saying “Wh're is mine own gift.”

item.title: Community Outreach Junior Staff Recruitment - Applications OPEN: Re: Community Outreach Recruitment - OPEN: Seeking Junior Staff for Introductions
item.content:encoded:
Why do you feel you should be a junior staff? Why the Community Outreach team?
I have been apart of this site for technically a year(I accidentally quit as a member to try to fix a problem with signing in) and I really enjoy reading people's SCP Ideas critiquing them and trying to help those beginners who didn't know that we have to use a specific template to post in the forums

How active are you?
I try to be active every day by checking & participating in forum discussions I often ask for help when I don't understand something(like why I can't log in into the custom domain) and enjoy reading the SCP articles on this site.

Which of the responsibilities listed above do you think you would be a good fit for and why?
I think I would be a really good responsibility that I am good at is reminding people about the rules and I have been known for when I was younger to remind my parents who were on their phones during dinner. That is why I want to join as a Junior Staff

item.title: Deletions 70: If the fact will not fit the theory – let the theory go.: Re: Deletions 70: If the fact will not fit the theory – let the theory go.
item.content:encoded:
scp-5168 (The Indestructible Man) by MuffinWolf deleted at -15 and three votes.

SCP-5168-2 appears to be the human male Private Mas Philip moulded with a carbon fibre-like material. Now labelled SCP-5168-1. SCP-5168-2 is 187m tall just as Private Maz was. Private Mas Philip was a former member of MTF Nu-7 ”Hammer Down” infantry force.

scp-5057 (The Secret Ingredient Is Mayo) by YummyBees deleted at -13 and three votes.

SCP-5057 is a ██████████ brand chocolate cake. Anomalous effects occur when a subject makes contact with the cake. The subject will be instantly transported to a child's birthday party in an alternate world, however, details vary between reports.

Feedback ported:

[+] from Quicksilvers
– hide block

+1 from me, simple and strange! Just a few things could be fixed up, though!

(he shifts nervously in his seat)

Usually when subjects do an action during an interview/recorded file, its italicized and is its own line. Here's an example from 4018:

PoI-4018-0: I know how easy it is to pretend that the old pretenses and euphemisms still hold up, and that people take the easy route when confronting things head on is hard. So I'm sorry for making things that much harder to cope with. But really, you know I had to do it to them.

PoI-4018-0 tosses a lit lighter onto the ground, igniting the gasoline. The fire spreads towards the recruitment center; shortly after it reaches the interior, the building goes up in flames.

PoI-4018-0: If I'm pissing you off, or…

Also, the other thing is this sentence:

The subject will be instantly transported to an alternate world which varies between subjects, however it is always a child's birthday party and a ██████████ chocolate cake is always being served.

"…it is always a child's birthday party" doesn't really fit the rest of the sentence (weird syntax) and maybe should be rewritten or reworded. The dialogue in the interview also seems a little stiff.

Sorry if I dumped a little too much crit - I just like the idea and it needs a little tweaking for it to shine more!

item.title: Deletions 70: If the fact will not fit the theory – let the theory go.: Re: Deletions 70: If the fact will not fit the theory – let the theory go.
item.content:encoded:
SCP-5306 is a Artificial Christmas Tree, previously manufactured and owned by the brand Macy’s, is fully decorated with Christmas ornaments, and is indistinguishable from a non-anomalous Artificial Christmas Tree. But, unlike a non-anomalous Christmas tree, object seems impervious to any type of hazard, such as heat. It is unknown if object is sentient, but all signs point to no.

Deleted at -15 and three votes.

Feedback Ported:

Scorpion451

+ show block
– hide block

It's not a terrible idea at the core, but there are a lot of spelling, grammar, and formatting issues here, and more importantly it doesn't go beyond just being a list of things and their traits.

I'd strongly suggest taking this through the greenlight and critique process, there's a salvageable idea here.

item.title: SCP Announcements 46: Aristotle Axolotl Throttle: Forum Crit Team - Staff Post
item.content:encoded:
Hey Agent Buzz: if you're looking for feedback on a draft, you'll want to head to the critique forums (The Ideas Critique forum is probably the best place to start, make sure you read the 'Required Reading' thread stickied to the top of the forum); this thread is for announcing newly posted SCPs, not SCPs drafts that are in your sandbox.

Further information on posting a SCP is available in the How to Write an SCP guide under the 'Posting' tab.
